notes: Reference only, not a measured host/board/model profile.
Two 2 GiB DDR3 banks are source/reference capacities; usable reserve, fragmentation and bank mapping are unknown.
Dual E5-2696v4: 44 physical cores, 88 logical threads, AVX2/FMA, total 1 TiB RAM. Do not infer per-NUMA capacity or PCIe locality.
PCIe Gen2x8 is endpoint capability only; negotiated link and directional payload bandwidth are unknown.
Aggregate GGUF/shard bytes cannot be divided into expert budgets; IQ2_XS is not openTPU FP4.
Preserve Strata hot experts, CPU cold experts, adaptive cache, full top10+shared, skip0 and MTP accepted-state rules.
